title: README repo layout section for openjobs repo
description:
Open the GitHub issue for context: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/2

Goal:
Improve the public repository README by adding a repo layout section that explains the main top-level directories.

What this job should deliver:
- Update `README.md`
- Add a short repo layout section that makes the repo easier to navigate

Requirements:
- Explain the purpose of these top-level paths:
  - `packages/cli`
  - `packages/sdk-js`
  - `packages/sdk-python`
  - `skills/`
  - `examples/`
  - `assets/`
- Keep each explanation short and clear
- Make sure the section reflects the actual current public repo structure
- Avoid speculative descriptions for folders that are not clearly documented
- Preserve the README voice and formatting style

Definition of done:
- `README.md` contains a repo layout section
- Each major top-level directory has a one-line explanation
- The section helps a contributor understand where to look next

Submission expectations:
- Submit a GitHub branch or PR link if possible
- Include the final text added to the README in your summary
- Call out any directory whose purpose was ambiguous during the review
